The '''Varada sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Bestal system/Legends|Bestal]] and [[Varada system/Legends|Varada systems]]. It was located beside the Outer Rim's [[Tunka sector/Legends|Tunka sector]] and [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. The Varada sector contained the [[Dentamma Nebula/Legends|Dentamma Nebula]].

==Behind the scenes==
According to the non-canon comic [[Polyhedron 97|''Polyhedron'' 97]], [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] owned the entire [[Sector/Legends|sector]] apart from the planet [[Bestal Three]] and the [[Kadal Asteroid Field]], which were owned by [[Fax Ventures]].
